set.body:
Found during Interaction 11 (bd-01M1Z9B4N6ZVWFKJQ2GCMYGYRX). With Scala.js 1.22.0 an optimized (fullLinkJS) browser bundle hangs whenever it compiles a plot, at both e891562 and the Interaction 11 head. The hang is in LayoutPhase.positionRange (modules/core/shared/src/main/scala/intaglio/CompilerPhases.scala around line 2810): the optimizer turns layer.rows.exists(_.statRow.isInstanceOf[StatRow.Ecdf[?]]) into a loop that never advances its iterator. This probably affects any optimized application compiling a plot without an ECDF layer. No gate catches it, because every browser suite and the consumer gate use fastLinkJS.

Acceptance:
1. A minimal reproduction pinned to the Scala.js version, then either a core workaround (e.g. an explicit loop or a precomputed flag) or an upstream Scala.js report with the reproduction.
2. A gate that links and runs at least one plot compile under fullLinkJS (consumer gate or a dedicated check), failing before the fix and passing after.
3. Record whether the performance budgets should also be measured on fullLinkJS.

Evidence: agent report in the Interaction 11 session, 2026-10-03.
set.title: [Intaglio] fullLinkJS bundle hangs compiling a plot (LayoutPhase.positionRange)
